candidates.summary: The diff deletes the comment saying AppState may be nil in minimal testing setups, and loadAppState now stops boot on a nil AppState and on a *GnoGenesisState, two shapes that booted at the merge base, the second being the one the repo's own default emitted
candidates.failure_scenario: An out-of-tree caller of the public gnoland.NewInMemoryNode builds its GenesisDoc with no AppState, the minimal setup the deleted comment (base app.go:396-397) names, or with &GnoGenesisState{...}, the shape NewDefaultGenesisConfig returned until this branch. At cfcbaf484 the InitChainer logged 'invalid AppState of type <nil>' and the node booted with stdlibs loaded and the valset seeded. At 4b45296ca the handshake returns 'InitChain rejected the genesis: invalid AppState of type <nil>' and the node never starts. The branch fixed its own constructor (node_inmemory.go) but not the decoder, so any other caller still using the old shape stops booting with no migration note. The ADR's Consequences name neither shape.
candidates.verify_by: Read gno.land/pkg/gnoland/app.go:490-498 at head (the switch has only GnoGenesisState and *GenesisStateRef cases; default returns the error) and base app.go:396-397 (the deleted comment). Boot NewInMemoryNode with Genesis.AppState=nil at base and at head: base boots, head returns the handshake error. Fix: add `case nil:` (log a warning, apply an empty state) and `case *GnoGenesisState: return cfg.applyInMemoryAppState(ctx, *state, reqInitialHeight)` to loadAppState, or name both shapes under the ADR's Consequences.

AppState may be nil mostly in some minimal testing setups; // so log a warning when that happens.`; grep -rnE '&(gnoland\.)?GnoGenesisState\{' outside _test.go: no hits, so no in-tree caller breaks (CI green agrees)
